Requirements and recommendations Before you set up Cross-Site Interconnect, your on-premises network sites must physically meet Google's network in a supported colocation facility, also known as a connection location.

supporting_pages.title: Cross-Site Interconnect overview \_|\_ Google Cloud Documentation
evidence_snippets: For the basic setup shown in the diagram, a Cross-Site Interconnect connection is provisioned at each site between Google's network and the on-premises router in a common colocation facility.

Encryption options The following encryption options are available depending on the wire group mode: For wire groups in VLAN mode, you can use MACsec for Cloud Interconnect to help you secure traffic on Cross-Site Interconnect connections, specifically between your on-premises router and Google's edge routers.
Your setup might be different if your on-premises router isn't in the same colocation facility as your Cross-Site Interconnect connection.
